features: \[2022.09.10\] We could provide all testing images of Places and CelebA inpainted by our MAT and other methods. Since there are too many images, please send an email to wenboli@cse.cuhk.edu.hk and explain your needs.
\[2022.06.21\] We provide a SOTA Places-512 model (Places\512\FullData.pkl) trained with full Places data (8M images). It achieves significant improvements on all metrics.
\[2022.06.19\] We have uploaded the CelebA-HQ-256 model and masks. Because the original model was lost, we retrained the model so that the results may slightly differ from the reported ones.
